p.font: This importer will only update pricelist items if one is found with the same characteristics and a different price, otherwise it will create a new item.
The fields checked to search for a pricelist element are: 'applied_on', 'pricelist_id', 'min_quantity', 'date_start' and 'date_end'.
The file to import must contain the following columns with these names:

li.font: name of the sale pricelist to which the created pricelist items will be associated. If it exists, it will be associated with it and, if it does not exist, it will be created automatically. This field is required.

corresponds to the field 'Apply on' of the pricelist item and indicates which option is applied. This field is required. Depending on the option selected, other fields become mandatory:
3_global (applies globally): no other associated mandatory fields have to be filled.
2_product_category (applies to a category): the "categ_id" field must be filled in.
1_product (applies to a product template): the "product_tmpl_id" field must be filled in.
0_product_variant (applies to a product variant): the "product_id" field must be filled in.
minimum quantity to which it applies.
start date on which it applies.
end date on which it applies.

corresponds to the 'Compute price' field of the pricelist item and indicates the way in which the price is calculated. This field is required. Depending on the option selected, other fields become mandatory:
fixed (a fixed price applies): the "fixed_price" field must be filled in.
percentage (a discount percentage is applied): the "percent_price" field must be filled in.
formula (a formula applies): the "base" field corresponding to the "Based on" field of the pricelist item must be filled in. The options in this field are:
list_price: public price.
standard_price: cost price.
pricelist: (other pricelist) the "base_pricelist_id" field must be filled in.
sale_price: sale reference price.
The rest of the fields are not mandatory:
price_discount: discount price.
price_surcharge: price surcharge.
price_round: rounding method.
price_min_margin: minimum margin.
price_max_margin: maximum margin.

p.font: If you wish you can add fields setting the name of the field as the column name. To see the name of the fields you must activate developer mode from the Settings/Activate developer mode menu.
